verdict.rationale: Self-hosting under an open-source license is a fair question for a scheduling product, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Motion as a hosted SaaS service: seat-based pricing, a cloud REST API at api.usemotion.com, and an embeddable calendar. Nothing mentions source code, container images, self-hosted deployment, or an open-source license.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full scheduling engine from source or a container image under an open-source license
